features.name: checking_status_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of checking account status from worst to best financial standing, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection of checking account health directly separates creditworthy applicants along a smooth continuous axis

features.name: savings_status_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of savings account status from lowest to highest savings, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous savings level score enables linear margin separation based on financial cushion

features.name: employment_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of employment duration from unemployed to long-term employed, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth employment stability score supports linear decision boundaries for creditworthiness

features.name: log_credit_amount_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed credit amount normalized by training mean and std to reduce skewness for linear models
features.expected_model_benefit: Log normalization reduces heavy tail of credit amounts, improving linear SVM margin quality

features.name: duration_normalized
features.description: Credit duration normalized to [0,1] using training min/max range
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized duration provides smooth continuous feature for linear margin on loan term risk

features.name: credit_burden_ratio
features.description: Ratio of log credit amount to duration capturing monthly repayment intensity, normalized by typical values
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite ratio captures repayment intensity as a single linear feature, useful for SVM hyperplane

features.name: financial_stability_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of checking status score, savings score, and employment score representing overall financial stability
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite score approximates a linear projection of financial health dimensions for SVM margin
features.formula: np.clip(0.4 * np.where(checking_status == '<0', 0.0, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 0.33, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 0.67, 1.0))) + 0.35 * np.where(savings_status == '<100', 0.0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 0.25, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 0.5, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 0.75, 1.0)))) + 0.25 * np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0.0, np.where(employment == '<1', 0.25, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 0.5, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 0.75, 1.0)))), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Age normalized to [0,1] using training min/max, capturing maturity and financial experience
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized age provides smooth continuous feature for linear separation based on borrower maturity

features.name: installment_to_credits_ratio
features.description: Ratio of installment commitment rate to existing credits, measuring per-credit payment burden
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures debt service intensity per existing credit line as a smooth ratio for linear models

features.name: property_collateral_score
features.description: Ordinal score of property magnitude as collateral quality from no property to real estate
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous collateral quality score enables linear margin based on asset backing of the loan
features.formula: np.where(property_magnitude == 'no known property', 0.0, np.where(property_magnitude == 'life insurance', 0.33, np.where(property_magnitude == 'car', 0.67, 1.0)))

features.name: credit_history_risk_score
features.description: Semantic risk score for credit history quality: 0=critical/other existing (highest risk), 0.25=delayed previously, 0.5=no credits/all paid (neutral), 0.75=all paid (good), 1.0=existing paid (best). Reflects repayment reliability signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Semantically ordered credit history score provides interpretable linear feature capturing repayment track record

features.name: purpose_risk_score
features.description: Semantic risk score for loan purpose: productive/stable purposes (used car=0.8, business=0.6, education=0.7) score higher than consumption (new car=0.4, radio/tv=0.5, furniture=0.5) with repairs/domestic lowest (0.2-0.3). Range 0.2 to 0.9.
features.expected_model_benefit: Purpose-based risk ordering provides a smooth semantic feature capturing loan use quality for linear SVM
